blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Voter registration in Naga City and Batanes will begin a week after their respective electoral exercises this month, instead of on the nationwide start date of Nov. 10, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairperson George Erwin Garcia said. Naga City will hold a plebiscite on Nov. 21 to determine whether it will become a highly urbanized city. Meanwhile, Batanes will hold special elections on Nov. 28 following the death of Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr. The registration schedule in the two areas will be adjusted to avoid confusion over who is eligible to vote in the upcoming plebiscite in Naga City and […]...
